changes.note: pg_policies.roles is now read and compared field for field against the pinned set ({public} on all 32 policies), with an explicit check that every policy is PERMISSIVE, for {public} and command ALL. Effective applicability is shown per login: connected as each of the 19 runtime logins, row_security_active() is true on every one of the 32 RLS tables.

USING governs existing rows read, updated or deleted; WITH CHECK governs rows written. On reference_clinical_state_v1, USING adds that the session has not been removed, so removed sessions cannot be read, updated or deleted. An inserted or updated row is checked only against the tenant, clinician and namespace condition. On the other 31 tables the two conditions are identical. The policy entries are byte-for-byte the 057 capture; only 'reading' and 'captured_from' changed. The 057 provenance folder is kept unchanged as history.
